dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Discrete 'O' and 'C' shaped structures are prominent on the posterior-dorsal flank. These feature a high-contrast transition from the dark base pelage to a narrow, high-intensity white band. The interior of the largest 'O' ring is low-intensity, creating a sharp void-like center.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of small, solid white pixel clusters along the dorsal ridge line. These clusters are asymmetrical, lacking internal gradients, and are more concentrated in the mid-dorsal region compared to the more sparse posterior lateral area.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest rings on the posterior flank form an obtuse scalene triangle. Five high-intensity blobs on the upper-mid-dorsal region form a zig-zag chain configuration oriented horizontally along the long axis.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinct topographical transition exists where the discrete annular markings of the posterior merge into a dense, interconnected reticulated pattern of white lines and blobs across the mid-body lateral field.
